1.title: Afghan Sentenced to 20 Years After Mixed Verdict in 2021 Kabul Attack Case
1.summary: A jury had split on whether Mohammad Sharifullah was to blame in a deadly bombing but found him guilty of aiding the terrorist group ISIS-K.

2.title: To a Binational Tribe, Trump’s Border Wall Feels Like Betrayal
2.summary: An escalating confrontation on Native land southwest of Tucson threatens to upend decades of uneasy cooperation between the Tohono O’odham Nation and the United States.

3.title: Stung by Voting Rights Decision, Many Black Southerners Plan for November
3.summary: Black Democratic candidates for governor, the Senate and the House are hoping that attacks on Black representation will motivate more voters.

4.title: What Is the E1 Project, Israel’s Disputed Settlement Plan in the West Bank?
4.summary: Israel’s right-wing government is opening bidding for thousands of housing units in a patch of the West Bank, a move that would thwart efforts at Palestinian statehood.

5.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
5.summary: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

6.title: Locals Call It the World’s Largest Cesspool, and Blame It for Surging Cancer
6.summary: For decades, the Mexican authorities have sacrificed a rural valley to flush away the capital’s waste and power the economy. Now, local communities are paying for that decision — often with peoples’ lives.
